## What did you try?

Include the LLM-PQR version and a minimal anonymized configuration or command.

## What constraint, capability, or trade-off was missing?

Examples: local-only, vision, tools, context length, a latency ceiling, or
structured output.

## Expected vs. actual recommendation

What did you expect to be selected or excluded, and what happened instead?

## Privacy check

- [ ] I removed API keys, tokens, passwords, private prompts, customer/patient
      data, internal URLs, and identifying telemetry.
